topic: Delaware Trust Act and Delaware Statutory Trust Act applicability
rule_summary: Delaware distinguishes common-law express trusts (DTA) from statutory trusts (DSTA). The DSTA applies only to trusts formed under its provisions.
Trust creation requires capacity, intent, property, lawful purpose, and ascertainable beneficiaries. Written instrument required for real property transfers.
exceptions: Oral trusts for personal property recognized with proof.
Charitable purpose trusts exempt from beneficiary ascertainability.

rule_summary: DAPT allows self-settled trust with creditor protection subject to strict conditions: irrevocable, no direct benefit to settlor, independent trustee, not fraudulent.
open_questions: Court interpretation of 'independent trustee' in ongoing cases.
Scope of federal preemption in bankruptcy court.

rule_summary: Delaware enforces spendthrift clauses. Exception creditors (support, government, tort) may reach protected distributions.
Delaware Directed Trust Act enables investment direction holders and administrative agents separate from the directed trustee.
Trustee with discretionary power may decant (distribute to a second trust) for beneficiaries, subject to perpetuities and trust instrument limits.
Delaware Secretary of State is central filing office. Fixture filings and local filings go to the county recorder.
Delaware imposes trust income tax on certain Delaware situs trusts. Situs established by governing law designation or Delaware trustee administration.
open_questions: Specific filing thresholds and exemption amounts require official guidance verification.

rule_summary: Trust protectors may remove trustees, modify terms, and consent to actions. Scope defined by instrument; fiduciary duties depend on exculpation.
NJSA can modify, terminate, or reform trust without court, with all interested parties' consent and no material purpose violation.
Delaware provides homestead and wage garnishment protections, subject to statutory limits and exceptions for mortgages, taxes, and government claims.
open_questions: Exact dollar amounts for homestead value cap require statutory verification.

rule_summary: Delaware recognizes tenancy by the entirety for married couples' real property, shielding it from single-spouse creditors.
exceptions: Divorce converts to tenancy in common.

rule_summary: Trusts may migrate to Delaware by changing governing law to Delaware and appointing a Delaware trustee, subject to original jurisdiction restrictions.
exceptions: Original jurisdiction may restrict outbound migration.
